tables.name: v_invoices
tables.description: One row per invoice, with its customer, dates, amounts and payment status. Use for revenue, billing, unpaid and overdue questions.

columns.name: invoice_number
columns.description: Invoice number shown to customers, e.g. INV-10423.

columns.name: total_amount
columns.description: Invoice total in USD, including tax.

columns.name: amount_paid
columns.description: Amount paid so far in USD.

metrics.name: revenue
metrics.description: Invoiced revenue in USD, excluding void invoices.
metrics.sql: SUM(CASE WHEN status <> 'void' THEN total_amount ELSE 0 END)

metrics.name: outstanding_balance
metrics.description: Unpaid balance in USD across invoices that aren't void.
metrics.sql: SUM(CASE WHEN status <> 'void' THEN total_amount - amount_paid ELSE 0 END)

exampleQuestions: What was revenue by month this year?
Which customers have the largest unpaid balances?

tables.name: v_customers
tables.description: One row per customer account: name, contact, region, signup date and whether the account is active.

columns.name: is_active
columns.description: True if the account is active.

exampleQuestions: How many active customers do we have per region?
Which customers signed up last month?

tables.name: v_tickets
tables.description: One row per support ticket: customer, category, priority, status, when it was opened and closed, and hours to resolve.

columns.name: closed_at
columns.description: When the ticket was closed; null while open.

columns.name: hours_to_resolve
columns.description: Hours from open to close; null while open.

metrics.name: open_tickets
metrics.description: Number of tickets not yet closed.
metrics.sql: SUM(CASE WHEN status <> 'closed' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)

exampleQuestions: How many urgent tickets are open?
What's the average time to resolve billing tickets by month?
